problems: Cliopatria's Gorkha Kingdom (1588..1787) and Nepal (1775..2024) rows are one state: in 1775 they are two halves of the modern outline. The nepal dossier starts in 1768 (Kingdom of Nepal, 25 September 1768) with gorkha-kingdom as predecessor; the gorkha-kingdom dossier (another batch) should end at 1768 and drop its 1769..1787 rows, which duplicate nepal's.

Sikh Empire: Cliopatria's 1800 shape (57,500 km2) beside a shrinking Sikh Confederacy row (5,600 then 3,100 km2) overlaps sikh-confederacy; the sikh-confederacy dossier should settle ownership 1800-1813.

Cross-dossier events the other groups should carry: british-empire protectorate over Lahore from Dec 1846 and the 1849 annexation; kashmir-and-jammu gains Kashmir on 16 March 1846 and gives Hazara back in early 1847; qing-dynasty records Nepal's Betrawati tribute; tibet records the 1841 Dogra invasion of Ngari.

Both dossiers use slug-like counterparts that have no dossier yet (kingdom-of-sikkim, kumaon-kingdom, garhwal-kingdom, kangra-state): the validator warns (6 in nepal, 1 in sikh-empire); they are listed above.
